notes.title: Sup #1 ? Webcam mode and fixes
notes.content:
Hey guys! Exciting news!
- We heard your comments, and we added a webcam mode that can both be used to change the webcam you are using, check its status in the UI, and even activate a screen with gizmos that shows your webcam image, and what the AI can detect in gameplay, perfect for streamers that want to share their reactions with their communities.
- We also fixed the menu buttons to be clickable by keyboard, mouse and even the hands controlled by the AI!

I want to hear more from you and I hope you guys have fun! K'bay!

notes.title: Watch the developer play
notes.content:
The Evil Fancy Ghost has kidnapped Plinio's family! Do you have what it takes to help this cute little blob rescue them?

It's time to lend a hand—literally—because we've released our improved public demo of [b]Plinio Needs a Hand[/b] as part of Next Fest!

In [b]Plinio Needs a Hand[/b], you assist Plinio on his quest by using cutting-edge computer vision AI algorithms that allow you to control different items in the game using only your hands through your webcam. Experience firsthand the unique gameplay as you navigate through the first ten stages of Level 1 and five stages of Level 2, each featuring special items, transformations, and abilities to discover.

But what if you want to get a grip on the game before diving in?

After all, forewarned is forearmed!

That's why we're hosting a live broadcast this Saturday, November 19, at [b]4 PM (GMT+2)[/b], where you'll get to watch us play through the demo, showcase tips and tricks, and see how to best help Plinio on his adventure.

[b]Mark your calendars:[/b]

- [b]Saturday at 4 PM (GMT+2)[/b]
- [b]11 AM in Brazil (Brasília Time)[/b]
- [b]10 AM Eastern Time (US)[/b]

We can't wait to see you there!

[b]Try out our latest demo here 👇[/b]
